## Summary

Describe the behavioral or documentation change.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows `type(scope)!: imperative summary`.
- [ ] No private journal or identifying user data is included.
- [ ] Instruction changes include before-and-after examples when useful.
- [ ] Breaking changes use `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer.
